description: Creative mode opening lines. Mood-based narrative openings for Creative stories. Not Scripture-based. Spoken by PAL before the length picker.

joyful.text: There are moments that feel brighter than the rest… this one starts there.
It began with something small that turned into something more.
Some stories begin in a place where the light just feels a little warmer.

grateful.text: There are things we almost miss… this story starts with one of those.
It began with a moment someone almost didn’t notice.
Some of the best things start quietly, almost without warning.

weary.text: There was a moment when everything felt like too much… this starts there.
It started in a place where the weight didn’t seem to lift.
Some stories begin when someone has nothing left to give.

anxious.text: There was a thought that wouldn’t quiet down… this story starts in that noise.
It began in the kind of silence that isn’t really silent at all.
Some stories start when the mind won’t stop circling.

hurting.text: There was a wound that didn’t show on the outside… this starts there.
It began in the kind of ache that’s hard to explain to anyone else.
Some stories begin in the place where it hurts the most.

brave_courage.text: There was a moment where fear and courage stood side by side.
It began with a choice that didn’t feel easy to make.
Some stories start with a step that took everything someone had.

calm_peaceful.text: There are moments that feel almost still, like time has slowed down.
It began in a quiet place, where everything felt steady for a while.
Some stories start in the kind of calm you don’t want to leave.

encouraging.text: There was a spark of something that hadn’t been there before.
It began with a feeling that something was about to shift.
Some stories start right at the edge of something new.
